history.summary: A 33-year-old (TOP 1993) 1,280 sqft 3BR freehold in D15 near Kembangan at $2.1M / $1,641 PSF. Old-vintage block ~990m from MRT, only 4 URA transactions and no usable appreciation rate; asking PSF is ~5% above the $1,562 median.
history.rating_rationale: Silahis is a dated 1993 freehold apartment in the East Coast belt — D15's deep buyer pool and freehold land are genuine supports (strong arena record 331-234, Elo 1267), and the $2.1M quantum sits in a liquid band. But at 33 years old the building faces rising maintenance and limited financing appeal, no usable URA appreciation rate exists (only 4 transactions), and the $1,641 asking PSF is ~5% over the $1,562 median. The 990m MRT walk is mediocre. Land/redevelopment optionality and freehold East Coast pedigree balance the age and thin data — a genuine Neutral.
red_flags: 33-year-old building (TOP 1993) — high maintenance, weaker financing/resale appeal
Only 4 URA transactions, no reliable appreciation rate
990m to Kembangan MRT — beyond prime walk band
catalysts: Freehold land in D15 East Coast with deep buyer pool
Long-run en-bloc/redevelopment optionality for an old freehold site
